# Kramare Cap

> > Detailed episode-by-episode recaps and reviews of Korean dramas from major networks including KBS 2TV, MBC, tvN, and SBS.

This blog specializes in comprehensive K-drama episode recaps, covering popular series like A Korean Odyssey (Hwayugi), My Golden Life, Witch's Court, and more. Each recap provides detailed plot summaries, character analysis, and key moments from individual episodes across romance, thriller, medical, and family drama genres.

## Key Topics

- K-drama recaps
- Episode summaries
- KBS 2TV dramas
- MBC dramas
- tvN dramas
- SBS dramas

- Oh Yeon-seo
- Weekend dramas
- Family dramas
